rv.q: The musical is much more successful in its score and its staging.
The rest is just pure dead brilliant.
This is a show to crease your face with a smile from start to finish, laced with thigh-slapping tunes, and enough warm-hearted, barmy adventure to keep young and old entertained this Christmas.

cn.t: Critics find this polished revival of the Oor Wullie musical charming and affectionate, with strong set design and an authentic feel. Mostly 4-star receptions, though some find it uneven. A crowd-pleasing show with clear nostalgic appeal.
